fields.phases[].exit_criteria: measurable; no dates, budgets or resources are assumed

phases.title: Source and business decisions
phases.prerequisites: access to the authorized source owner and business SMEs; the decision register
phases.required_evidence: corrected/missing source members and signed decisions
phases.exit_criteria: readiness re-run shows the source-category checks passing for the affected programs; the corresponding gaps disappear on reconversion

phases.title: External environments
phases.prerequisites: project owner approval for environments; platform engineering
phases.required_evidence: DB2, CICS, legacy environment definitions, platform services, COBOL runtime or captured runs
phases.exit_criteria: captured runs exist for each external outcome; boundary gaps have specifications

phases.title: Governed Java implementation
phases.prerequisites: Phase A/B evidence; trust store, signed disclosure authorization, G2/G3/G4 approvals, runner and egress (BMad)
phases.required_evidence: verified LIVE BMad receipts and approved stories
phases.exit_criteria: bmad governance verdict BMAD_COMPLIANT for the scope; converter changes with regression tests

phases.title: Independent verification
phases.prerequisites: Phase C implementation; legacy runtime (Phase B)
phases.exit_criteria: accepted F6 receipts; scenarios agree with legacy outputs

phases.title: Readiness reassessment
phases.required_evidence: a re-run of the engineering gates, readiness and the STEP 22 reconciliation
phases.exit_criteria: readiness, validation and reconciliation re-run; reverse diagrams regenerated; remaining gaps re-registered
